description:
Calculates real-time cryptocurrency swap estimates, network fees, deposit limits, and routing URLs across 240+ multi-chain pairs.

USAGE GUIDELINES:
- USE WHEN: The user requests an exchange rate calculation or wants an on-chain routing URL between two specific assets (e.g., BTC to XMR, USDT to SOL).
- DO NOT USE: Checking coin availability (call 'list_supported_currencies') or inspecting boundary limits without an amount (call 'get_pair_limits_and_fees'). Unsuitable for fiat currencies or bank transfers.

PARAMETER SEMANTICS & ROUTING:
- Inbound ('from') and outbound ('to') must be distinct supported tickers.
- Tickers are case-insensitive.
- Input 'USDT' evaluates to TRON (TRC20); pass 'USDTERC' for Ethereum mainnet.
- When 'amount' is outside provider thresholds ('min_amount' / 'max_amount'), the calculation executes, but 'within_limits' returns false.

BEHAVIOR, TIMEOUTS & CACHING:
- Strictly read-only without side effects.
- Liquidity feeds cached for 30 seconds at the edge.
- Returns JSON error object if upstream liquidity feed is unreachable or pair is unrouted.

amount.description: Inbound volume to exchange. Evaluated against provider liquidity depth to determine 'within_limits' acceptance.

from.description: Inbound asset ticker determining source blockchain and deposit address protocol. Must differ from destination.

to.description: Outbound asset ticker determining destination blockchain network and settlement ledger. Must differ from source.

name: get_swap_quote
